title.zh-TW: 筆案例的變體：教授也可以拿

subtitle.zh-TW: 規定改成教授也能拿筆後，兩人的因果評分變得接近。
subtitle.en: Once professors may take pens too, the two causal ratings move toward each other.

story.zh-TW: 考慮系辦筆案例的變體，只改動一處：這次系上的規定是行政人員與教授都可以取用筆筒裡的筆。某天早上，一位助教和一位教授差不多同時走進系辦，各自拿走一支筆。不久後秘書需要記錄一則重要訊息，才發現筆筒已經空了。
story.en: Consider the same office as in the pen case, with one change: this time the department's rule lets both administrative staff and professors take pens from the cup. One morning an administrative assistant and a professor walk in at about the same time and each takes a pen. Soon afterwards the secretary needs to write down an important message and finds the cup empty.

zh-TW.sentence: 這次系上的規定是行政人員與教授都可以取用筆筒裡的筆。
不久後秘書需要記錄一則重要訊息，才發現筆筒已經空了。

en.sentence: this time the department's rule lets both administrative staff and professors take pens from the cup.
Soon afterwards the secretary needs to write down an important message and finds the cup empty.

explanation.zh-TW: 模型與原版筆案例相同（Halpern 與 Hitchcock 2015, §7.2）：PO = PT·AT。差別只在規範：規定允許兩人拿筆，所以預設值（default value）是兩人都拿（PT = 1、AT = 1）。任一人不拿筆的世界偏離在不拿筆，實際世界偏離在筆筒空了，兩者無法比較，不算至少一樣正常，所以帶常態（normality）的 HP 定義判兩人都不是原因；but-for 與其他 HP 定義仍判兩人是原因。實驗中教授 3.0、助教 3.53（量尺 1 至 7），都低於中點；原版是教授 4.05、助教 2.51（Sytsma、Livengood 與 Rose 2010）。
explanation.en: The model is the same as in the original pen case (Halpern and Hitchcock 2015, §7.2): PO = PT·AT. Only the norm differs. The rule permits both to take a pen, so taking is the default for each (PT = 1, AT = 1). Under the normality clause, the witness world in which either one does not take a pen deviates in that taking, the actual world in the empty cup; the two cannot be compared, so the witness is not at least as normal and neither is a cause; the but-for test and the other HP definitions still count both. This contrasts with the original case, where the professor's taking is forbidden and only the professor is a cause. In the experiment (Sytsma, Livengood and Rose 2010, scale 1 to 7) the professor was rated 3.0 and the assistant 3.53: both below the midpoint and close together, against 4.05 and 2.51 in the original. When the rule permits both, taking is the norm and neither is singled out as the cause.

sources.citation: Halpern, J. Y., & Hitchcock, C. (2015). Graded causation and defaults. British Journal for the Philosophy of Science, 66(2), 413–457.

note.zh-TW: 變體與評分（3.0 與 3.53）出自該文註 12 轉述的 Sytsma、Livengood 與 Rose (2010)，不是 Knobe 與 Fraser 的原實驗。
note.en: The variant and the ratings (3.0 and 3.53) are reported in note 12 of the paper, from Sytsma, Livengood and Rose (2010); they are not part of Knobe and Fraser's original experiment.

sources.citation: Knobe, J., & Fraser, B. (2008). Causal judgment and moral judgment: two experiments. In W. Sinnott-Armstrong (Ed.), Moral Psychology, Vol. 2 (pp. 441–447). MIT Press.

note.en: The original pen vignette, from which the variant is derived.

verdicts.note: Both takes are the default: each witness world (not taking) deviates in that taking, the actual world in PO; the two are incomparable, so neither passes AC2+(a).

text.zh-TW: 規定允許兩人拿筆時，教授（3.0）與助教（3.53）的因果評分（量尺 1 至 7）都低於中點，且彼此接近。
text.en: When the rule permits both, the professor (3.0) and the assistant (3.53) receive causal ratings (scale 1 to 7) that both sit below the midpoint and close together.
